scientific_integrity: The finite claims have two exhaustive enumerators and dual square-flip tests; an explicit parity-slice argument proves the infinite lower bound. Reproducibility is self-review only, with no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact graph census holds only in dimensions 2, 3 and 4.
For dimensions at least four, only a lower bound on frozen matchings is shown, not an exact enumeration.
Unindexed equivalent square-flip results could exist.
title: Square-flip freezing starts in \(Q_4\): eight isolated dimers and infinitely many higher-dimensional frozen matchings
